Indian Overseas Bank LBO Exam Date 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Indian Overseas Bank (IOB) has released the exam date for the post of Local Bank Officer (LBO). This recruitment was released for 250 posts. Applications for the Indian Overseas Bank LBO Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 08 August 2026, to 24 August 2026. The written examination is going to be conducted on 24 & 29 September 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can check their Indian Overseas Bank LBO Exam Date 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 08 August 2026
  • Last Date : 24 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 24 August 2026
  • Exam Date : 24 & 29 September 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • For General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 850/-
  • For SC, ST & PwBD : Rs. 175/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
